__doc__: Caption styles for the clip pipeline. 'base' is the Outset house style (the 'EP16 v2' look: one-line white Georgia Bold, no stroke, rounded bright-red #F31400 active-word highlight box with corner radius = 0.28 x box height, at 71% of frame height, max 3 words on screen). Georgia Bold is the macOS system font; if it is missing the pipeline warns and falls back to the bundled EB Garamond (fonts/EBGaramond-Regular.ttf), which also remains an optional alternate. Each platform override layers on top of base, changing ONLY the fields it names — set 'font' (an absolute path or a repo-relative fonts/<x>.ttf) here to give a posting spot its own typeface. Precedence at render time: SHORTS_<FIELD> env var > platform override > base > built-in default. Select a platform with SHORTS_PLATFORM (youtube | linkedin | x | youtube_longform); unset = base only. Format (aspect ratio) is a separate axis: SHORTS_FORMAT.
